commands: echo "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-unset}"; echo "---PR---"; gh pr view 1474 --json number,title,headRefOid,baseRefName,state,url,closingIssuesReferences,body 2>&1 | head -60

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" && [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] && git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"
for f in skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/shadow-review.md; do printf "%s  " "$f"; sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1; done

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
cp .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1474/run/diff.patch "$tmp/d.patch"
git worktree add -q "$tmp/wt" HEAD 2>/dev/null
cd "$tmp/wt" && git apply "$tmp/d.patch" 2>&1 | head
sha256sum skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/shadow-review.md
git worktree remove --force "$tmp/wt" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$tmp"

git worktree add -q /tmp/wt1474 HEAD && git -C /tmp/wt1474 apply /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1474/run/diff.patch && sha256sum /tmp/wt1474/skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md /tmp/wt1474/skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md /tmp/wt1474/skills/review-and-fix/references/shadow-review.md; git worktree remove --force /tmp/wt1474

rm -rf /tmp/rev1474 && mkdir -p /tmp/rev1474 && git archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -x -C /tmp/rev1474 && git apply --directory=/tmp/rev1474 .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1474/run/diff.patch && echo APPLIED_OK

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
